image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, showing the broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two stalked eyes protrude from the front margin. The large chelipeds (claws) are visible in the foreground, appearing robust with serrated inner edges and dark tips. Several walking legs extend laterally from beneath the carapace. The texture appears hard and calcified.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike crab species or generic 'crab' generations.
To verify the structural integrity of the shell boundaries and ensure no melting or fusion between the claws and the body/background.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the exoskeleton or background blur that might indicate AI generation artifacts.
To ensure proper spatial separation between the crab's protruding eyes/claws and the background elements.

focus_areas: Serration pattern on claw inner edges for biological accuracy
Texture consistency of the carapace (smooth vs. noisy)
Boundary sharpness between the crab and the background
Symmetry and placement of the stalked eyes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'serrated inner edges' of the claws. AI models often struggle with repeating geometric patterns like teeth, resulting in melting or irregular spacing. Also, verify if the eye stalks connect naturally to the carapace without blending artifacts.
